key_features: TARGETING SKIN CONCERNS: This duo includes our best-selling hydrogel masks. Collagen mask is optimal for skin with enlarged pores by effectively improving skin elasticity. Cera-nol mask is perfect for irritated, sensitive skin with redness and provides calming and deep moisturizing effects.

Biodance Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask is a hydrogel type mask. Each mask holds 34 grams of pure essence and gradually becomes transparent as ingredients get absorbed. It is an all-in-one product as it improves enlarged pore size, improves skin firmness, and deeply hydrates skin layers.

Biodance Hydro Cera-nol Real Deep Mask is a hydrogel type mask. Each mask holds 34 grams of pure essence and gradually becomes transparent as ingredients get absorbed. It is an all-in-one product as it provides instant cooling, quick soothing and deep hydration.
SAFE FOR PROLONGED USE: Our hydrogel masks do not include PEG-100 Stearate. Instead, naturally derived ingredients such as Algin and Algar are used to ensure safety for overnight use.
pros: Delivers intense overnight hydration and a long-lasting glass skin glow
Combines collagen firming with ceramide barrier-repair ingredients
Hydrogel material adheres tightly to maximize active ingredient absorption
cons: Requires several hours to dry down completely clear
Hydrogel material can feel slightly slippery upon initial application
